headline: Iran Claims Major Damage to US Air Defenses as Conflict Widens
subheadline: Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps says it damaged a significant portion of U.S. air defense infrastructure in the region.
lede: The Middle East conflict intensified dramatically today as the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed to have destroyed a significant portion of U.S. air defense infrastructure in the region, while threatening that any country supporting America becomes a legitimate target. Meanwhile, the IDF conducted precise airstrikes eliminating Hamas commanders Abu Gazaal and Riyad al-Menchie in the West Bank. Regional involvement expanded as UAE and Ukraine carried out military actions against Iranian assets, with diplomatic efforts ongoing through Oman.

sections.title: Drone Strikes Escalate on Both Sides
sections.body: Russian forces targeted logistics hubs in Zaporizhzhia and Odessa, striking drone production and port infrastructure. Ukrainian forces responded with strikes on military-industrial sites in Kursk and Rostov, including a fuel depot and drone assembly facility. The Belgorod region reported over 40 casualties from drone attacks, with one fatality in Berezovka. Despite Russian claims of shooting down 210 drones, 16 reached Moscow's vicinity.

sections.title: Regional Powers Clash with Iranian Forces
sections.body: The IDF eliminated Hamas commanders Abu Gazaal and Riyad al-Menchie through precise airstrikes in the West Bank. UAE conducted air strikes against Iranian storage facilities and military sites, indicating regional cooperation against Iran. Ukrainian forces struck a Russian warship and vessels carrying Iranian military equipment in the Caspian Sea. Iran's Foreign Minister condemned the attack on an Iranian commercial vessel and called for a UN Security Council response.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Cross-border military actions by UAE and Ukraine against Iranian assets signal widening regional involvement that could rapidly expand the conflict. The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps' threat to target any U.S. supporting nation escalates the risk of broader confrontation. On the Eastern front, Russian mobilization preparations amid reported losses of 225,500 personnel suggest sustained attritional warfare with increasing civilian impact.
